stories.title: Buse Wins Winston-Salem — Historic Peruvian Champion Heads to US Open

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Buse wins Winston-Salem — 6-3, 6-2 over Fery. The 22-year-old Peruvian is the youngest champion in tournament history and has his second ATP title of 2026. He heads to the US Open with momentum. #TFRtennis #WinstonSalem #Tennis

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: History: Ignacio Buse becomes the first Peruvian player to win an ATP Tour final since 2004. 6-3, 6-2 over Arthur Fery in Winston-Salem. Youngest champion in tournament history at 22. #TFRtennis #Tennis #ATPTour
